description: Redmi Note 18 series is expected to be in the works as a successor to the Redmi Note 17 lineup. Xiaomi has yet to confirm its arrival, but ahead of it, a Redmi Note 18 series model has allegedly received 3C (China Compulsory Certification). The listing confirms the charging speed. All three smartphones from the Redmi Note 18 lineup have reportedly received the 3C certification so far. The lineup is tipped to include a Redmi Note 18 Pro Max model with a large 10,000mAh battery.
title: Redmi Note 18 Series Phone Reportedly Spotted on 3C Certification Site; Charging Speed Tipped

description: Claude Meetings adds an AI participant to workplace video calls, where teams can ask questions, create shared documents and retrieve information from connected services. The assistant also keeps a record of discussions, including transcripts, summaries and action items, which participants can revisit later. Anthropic has included controls for meetings involving external guests and says Claude does not record audio. The beta is limited to Google Meet users on Team and Enterprise plans, with some enterprise security configurations excluded for now.
title: Claude Meetings Launched in Beta for Team and Enterprise Subscribers: Features, Availability

description: Meta's Muse AI assistant can now place outgoing calls. The update allows the AI agent to make calls to restaurants, insurance providers and other businesses on behalf of paid subscribers in the US. The feature was previously available to a limited group of users for testing. The outbound calling on Muse is designed to save users time spent managing routine phone-based interactions.
title: Meta Muse AI Can Now Make Phone Calls to Businesses for Paid Subscribers

description: South Korean cryptocurrency exchange Upbit has suspended Osmosis (OSMO) deposits and withdrawals following a network-wide outage that stopped block production on the blockchain. The restriction does not affect OSMO trading on the exchange, allowing customers to continue buying and selling the token. Bithumb has also halted deposits and withdrawals, while Coinbase reported transaction delays. Infrastructure provider QuickNode confirmed that the network stalled on November 12 and said it was investigating the disruption.
title: South Korea’s Upbit Pauses OSMO Deposits and Withdrawals After Network Failure

description: Samsung's Galaxy A18 5G has surfaced in the Bluetooth SIG database, where seven model numbers point to variants intended for different markets. The certification offers little insight into the phone itself, and Samsung has not confirmed its hardware or launch plans. The handset is expected to sit alongside the Galaxy A18 4G, which arrived in September. Its predecessor, the Galaxy A17 5G, launched in India in August 2025 with an Exynos chipset, a 90Hz AMOLED display and a 5,000mAh battery.
title: Samsung Galaxy A18 5G Spotted on Bluetooth SIG Ahead of Expected Launch

description: Bitcoin treasury firm Nakamoto has amended its $165 million debt agreement with Kraken, extending the deadline for a $60 million repayment by one year. The revised terms come as the company's market capitalisation has fallen to approximately $104 million, below its outstanding loan balance. Nakamoto has pledged 3,030 BTC as collateral, currently valued at around $208.5 million based on Bitcoin's market price. The agreement also allows Kraken to account for Bitcoin derivative positions when calculating collateral maintenance and margin requirements.
title: Bitcoin Firm Nakamoto Extends Debt Deal as Stock Valuation Takes a Hit

description: Xiaomi could unveil the Xiaomi 18 Pro and the Redmi Note 17 Aura in India during the first week of January. Xiaomi 18 Pro is tipped to go on sale in the country the following week.  Xiaomi is reportedly planning to bring the Xiaomi 18T to the Indian market around March or April 2027. The Xiaomi 18 Pro could be priced around Rs. 1,50,000 in India. Xiaomi has not officially confirmed the smartphone's India launch plans or pricing details so far.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro, Redmi Note 17 Aura India Launch Tipped for January 2027; Xiaomi 18T Could Arrive Later

description: OpenAI's latest update gives ChatGPT Dots more ways to adapt to individual users. Custom instructions can set preferences for an agent's replies and tell it when to seek approval, while existing permission controls and Custom Rules continue to govern access to connected apps and specific actions. The changes arrive alongside other recent additions to Dots, including the ability to interact with agents through iMessage and RCS. That messaging feature remains in testing for eligible ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US.
title: ChatGPT Dots Can Now Follow Custom Instructions on Mobile, Web and Desktop

description: WhatsApp is said to be developing a new feature that could make it easier to share location updates through its Status section. The Meta-owned messaging platform currently allows users to share their location through a sticker placed over a photo or video, though it requires selecting a background before adding the location information. According to a feature tracker, the in-development feature could remove this limitation by introducing a dedicated Location option in the Status composer.
title: WhatsApp Reportedly Testing Native Location Sharing for Status Updates on Android

description: The UPI Vyapaar Saksham Scheme could be launched soon by NPCI, as a leaked memo has surfaced online. The scheme aims to expand the acceptance of the digital payments interface, facilitate the onboarding of new merchants, and to grow the number of UPI transactions. The scheme will focus on Tier 3 to Tier 6 centres, North-Eastern states, and the Union Territories of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh. The UPI Vyapaar Saksham Scheme might have a sunset period of three years from the date of implementation of the Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) charges, which was earlier expected to come into effect after Diwali. Coming to the incentive structure, NPCI is said to offer an incentive of 0.03 percent of the aggregate value of eligible transactions to small merchants. Meanwhile, shopkeepers and other merchants located in “Targeted Geographies” will receive a 50 percent additional incentive on the base rate.
title: NPCI to Introduce UPI Vyapaar Saksham Scheme to Offer Incentives to Small Merchants, Aims to Promote Acceptance

description: Spotify announced the launch of audiobooks in India on Thursday. The music streaming platform is bringing more than 3,50,000 English titles and nearly 7,000 audiobooks in Indian languages at launch, spanning classics, bestsellers and regional literature. Audiobooks carry features like personalised recommendations, offline listening, sleep timers and a tool that synchronises audiobook playback with a reader's physical book. Spotify is also introducing a monthly subscription plan that offers 15 hours of audiobook listening.
title: Spotify Launches Audiobooks in India With Regional Language Titles, Standalone Plan

description: Binance has confirmed that it has replaced all user assets affected by the $6.3 billion security incident in October. The exchange said customers would be able to verify their 1:1 asset backing once its latest Proof of Reserves process is completed. The recovery involved three funding sources: its Secure Asset Fund for Users (SAFU), Futures Insurance Funds and corporate cash reserves. However, Binance has not disclosed the final allocation between these sources or provided a timeline for the updated reserves report.
title: Binance Confirms $6.3 Billion Hack Losses Covered, New Reserve Disclosure Still Pending

description: X has increased its media attachment limit to 20 photos and videos per post. The microblogging platform previously allowed users to share up to four photos and videos per post. The expanded media-sharing functionality is already available on the web, while users on Android and iOS may need to install the latest version of the X app to access it.
title: X Now Lets Users Share Up to 20 Photos and Videos in a Single Post

description: The Vivo X500 series could carry printed maximum retail prices of up to Rs. 2,14,999 in India, according to a new leak. The figures reportedly apply to the 12GB RAM and 256GB storage variants of the X500, X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max. An earlier leak had suggested considerably lower retail prices for the same lineup. Vivo is expected to reveal the official prices when the three flagship smartphones launch in India alongside the Watch GT 2 on November 26.
title: Vivo X500 Series Box Prices Leaked Ahead of November 26 India Launch

description: Ahead of its official launch in India, Vivo has revealed the features of its first smartwatch, called the Watch GT 2. The Watch GT2 was recently launched in China alongside the Vivo X500 series and is now making its way to India. Its key highlights include a large display, plenty of health tracking features and a claimed 25-day battery life.
title: Vivo Watch GT 2 Features Officially Revealed Ahead of India Launch

description: Apple delayed the launch of the iPhone 18 because of a new deal with Samsung, according to a report. The tech giant was reportedly unable to secure an adequate quantity of camera sensors it needed for mass production. The Cupertino company has reportedly been sourcing camera sensors exclusively from Sony. The report now highlights that Sony executives have confirmed that its long-standing partnership with the iPhone maker has come to an end. To diversify its supply, Apple struck a deal with Samsung in August last year, which reportedly allowed the company to “strengthen its manufacturing” base in the US. As part of the new deal, Samsung is said to supply CMOS camera sensors for the newer iPhone models, produced at the South Korean tech giant’s facility in Austin, Texas.
title: Apple's iPhone 18 is Missing From This Year's Lineup, and Samsung Could Be the Reason

description: Microsoft is experiencing a major global outage that has disrupted Outlook, Teams and several other Microsoft 365 services. This has left users unable to access emails, calendars, and workplace tools. The disruption began on November 12 and has since continued into the following day, affecting individuals, businesses and government organisations across multiple countries, including India. The Redmond-based tech giant has attributed the problems to infrastructure and connectivity issues, but restoring normal service has proved more difficult than expected.
title: Microsoft Outlook Outage Explained: What Caused It, What Is Affected and Why Is It Taking So Long to Fix?

description: Vivo X500 series' additional details have been revealed via the updated microsites in India. The Vivo X500 will be available for purchase in India in Ember Red and Titanium Black colour options. On the other hand, the Vivo X500 Pro and Vivo X500 Pro Max will be offered in Apex Orange and Eternal Black colourways. The standard model is also confirmed to feature a triple rear camera unit, headlined by a Zeiss Pro-Level Ultra-Sensing primary camera, along with a Zeiss Ultra Wide-Angle camera and a 64-megapixel telephoto camera with a 1/2-inch Zeiss APO sensor, 72mm focal length, and CIPA 5.5 Professional Stabilisation.
title: Vivo X500 Series Camera Configuration and Colour Options Revealed Ahead of India Launch

description: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has announced that Wolfenstein 3 is now in development at MachineGames. The game is officially in production at the Swedish studio, with series protagonist BJ Blazkowicz set to return. The title will mark MachineGames’ return to the Wolfenstein franchise after Indiana Jones: The Great Circle.
title: Wolfenstein 3 Is Officially in Production at MachineGames, Xbox Confirms

description: Apple's online store in India has been updated to reflect the adjusted trade-in values for iPhone models. While buying a new Apple device, customers can trade in their older iPhone 17 for up to Rs. 54,000. Meanwhile, the iPhone 15 Plus can be traded in for up to Rs. 33,000. These values reflect the trade-in value of handsets in “Good” condition. Damaged devices could receive a lower trade-in value from the tech giant. Apart from this, Apple has added various Samsung foldables to the list of devices eligible for trade-in. Customers can get up to Rs. 63,000 for the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 7. The list has been updated to include the Galaxy Z Fold 4, Galaxy Z Fold 3 5G, Galaxy Z Fold 2 5G, and the first-generation Galaxy Z Fold, with a maximum trade-in value of Rs. 21,000, Rs. 14,000, Rs. 12,500, and Rs. 9,000, respectively.
title: Apple Adjusts Trade-In Values in India and Adds Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 7 to the List

description: Samsung and Google have collectively launched their new range of intelligent eyewear. The wearables come in a variety of designs and support prescription lenses, for those who need it. They are powered by Google’s Android XR software platform and now we have learnt that they support a new “Hey Gemini” hotword, which isn’t supported on Android smartphones yet.
title: Google Introduces 'Hey Gemini' Voice Command for Android XR Smart Glasses

description: Google announced Gemini 4 Hydrogen on Thursday as its latest AI model that brings faster AI assistance to everyday tasks. Instead of extended reasoning, the Mountain View-based tech giant claims it is aimed at coding, research and agentic workflows that require quick execution. Gemini 4 Hydrogen is available across Google's developer tools, enterprise services, Gemini app and Search, while being positioned as a more accessible option compared to the company’s other AI models.
title: Google Rolls Out Gemini 4 Hydrogen for Faster Coding and Agentic AI Workflows

description: LinkedIn is reportedly working on a new feature to help you identify frequent profile visitors. The platform is testing a feature that could show Premium subscribers how many times a particular user has visited their profile within a specified period. The badge currently appears to be restricted to select LinkedIn Premium subscribers. This suggests that, like LinkedIn's previously launched premium features, profile-visitor insights will be available behind a paid subscription tier.
title: LinkedIn Testing Frequent Profile Viewer Feature for Premium Subscribers: Report

description: Huawei's next foldable lineup could bring several hardware changes over the Mate X7 series. The Mate X8 is tipped to feature a larger inner display, a Kirin 9050 series chipset and a battery exceeding 6,000mAh. Camera upgrades could include a variable-aperture primary sensor and support for Huawei's external 10x zoom camera module. The foldable may also introduce a Privacy Display feature to restrict viewing angles. Huawei is reportedly preparing to announce the Mate X8 series alongside the MateBook Fold S.
title: Huawei Mate X8 Series Launch Date, Specifications Tipped: What to Expect

description: Bitcoin declined below its 200-day moving average as institutional withdrawals, tighter crypto liquidity and expectations of a December Federal Reserve rate hike pressured the market. Ethereum and other major cryptocurrencies also faced weakness, while analysts identified $70,000 as an important level to watch for Bitcoin’s recovery
title: Bitcoin Slips Below $69,000 as Institutional Selling and Weak Liquidity Pressure Crypto Market

description: Samsung’s rumoured S27 Pro model is surely turning out to be an interesting device. It appears to leave behind the baggage of the Ultra models and offer an Ultra shooting experience minus the S Pen and the 5X telephoto camera. Now, we have more details about its 3X telephoto zoom camera.
title: Samsung’s Galaxy S27 Pro Tipped to Get Same Cameras as the S27 Ultra Minus the 5X Telephoto

description: Smartphone cameras have evolved considerably since their inception, with manufacturers continually finding new ways to improve image quality without increasing camera module size. Recent developments have pushed the boundaries of mobile photography, with technologies such as LOFIC (Lateral Overflow Integration Capacitor) emerging as one way to improve dynamic range. Now, a new optical technology could offer another significant upgrade. Called HoloCoder, it may potentially improve low-light photography, preserve details in challenging lighting conditions, and even capture depth information.
title: Your Smartphone Camera Could Soon Capture More Light, Snap Better Photos With This New Tech

description: Signify has launched new EcoLink water heaters and WinterComfort OFR room heaters. The latest lineup includes storage and instant water heater models in different capacities, along with digital and analogue oil-filled radiator heaters. The EcoLink instant water heaters are priced starting at Rs. 5,999.
title: Signify Launches EcoLink Water Heaters, WinterComfort OFR Room Heaters in India

description: Id Software has begun work on its next game. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma announced Friday that id Software was working on its next project. The developer confirmed the project and said it was "incredibly excited" about the title. The game will be directed by Hugo Martin, who served as game director on Doom: Eternal and Doom: The Dark Ages.
title: Id Software Confirms Its Next Game Is in Development, Led by Doom Director Hugo Martin

description: Amazon on Thursday announced the rollout of its AI-powered shopping assistant in India. The e-commerce giant says its feature, dubbed Alexa for Shopping, brings personalised product recommendations, price tracking, and conversational shopping tools to its app and website. Alexa for Shopping leverages Amazon's product discovery assistant Rufus, along with the personalised context and capabilities of Alexa+. It can help users research products, compare prices and features, find deals, and add frequently purchased items to their shopping baskets using natural language prompts.
title: Amazon Rolls Out Alexa for Shopping in India With Personalised AI Assistance, Deal Alerts

description: Microsoft rolled out the November 2026 update for Windows 11 on Thursday. The Redmond-based tech giant is bringing improvements to File Explorer, system recovery, and accessibility features. It introduces a redesigned right-click menu with more customisation options, along with a new Cloud Rebuild feature that can reinstall Windows using files downloaded from Windows Update. The November 2026 update for Windows 11 also adds enhancements to Magnifier, Live Captions and Narrator, while making changes to Xbox mode, Settings and Phone Link.
title: Windows 11 Gets New Recovery Option, Multi-Monitor Magnifier Features With Latest Update

description: Oppo A7 Pro launched in the European market. It features a 6.57-inch AMOLED display with up to 120Hz refresh rate. Oppo A7 Pro runs on a MediaTek Dimensity 6360 Max chipset. It was launched in China in September. It comes with a 7,400mAh battery with support for 80W wired fast charging. It also features a 50-megapixel selfie camera, an upgrade over the 8-megapixel selfie shooter available on the Chinese model.
title: Oppo A7 Pro Launched Globally With 7,400mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Selfie Shooter: Price, Specifications

description: Apple CarPlay users will soon be able to access Google's Gemini app from their car displays. The update brings Gemini Live voice conversations to Apple's in-car platform, along with Google Calendar and Gmail functions. Drivers can ask about appointments, get email summaries, find restaurants and look up places along a route. Google says users must open Gemini Live on their iPhones and enable microphone access. Conversations made during a drive will sync with the iPhone app for later reference.
title: Google Gemini Comes to Apple CarPlay With Gemini Live, Gmail and Calendar Integration

description: Samsung has launched Gentle Monster and Warby Parker Intelligent Eyewear in select global markets. Samsung’s smart glasses are currently available for pre-order in the US. Customers can purchase the Intelligent Eyewear models via the Gentle Monster and Warby Parker online and offline retail stores, respectively. The wearables will be available for hands-on demonstrations at select Samsung retail stores starting December 10 and will go on sale on the same day. The Samsung Gentle Monster and Warby Parker Intelligent Eyewear is powered by Qualcomm’s Snapdragon AR 1 Gen 1 chipset.
title: Samsung Launches Gentle Monster, Warby Parker Intelligent Eyewear in 30 Unique Designs: Price, Features

description: Nvidia's Board of Directors has announced that Jensen Huang has resigned as the company's Chief Executive Officer (CEO), President, and member of Nvidia’s Board of Directors, effective immediately. The Board has appointed Colette Kress as the Interim CEO of Nvidia, while launching a hunt for the next full-time CEO. The new Nvidia interim CEO will continue to serve in her current roles, with additional charge of the company’s day-to-day management. Apart from this, Nvidia’s Board of Directors has appointed its “first-ever” Chairman. Harvey C. Jones has been an entrepreneur, technology executive, and an active venture investor with a combined experience of 30 years.
title: Meet Colette Kress: The CFO Replacing Nvidia's Jensen Huang

description: Microsoft Outlook is down in India and other global markets. In the early hours of Friday, Gadgets 360 staff members discovered that Microsoft’s email service, Outlook, was not delivering or sending emails. Later, it was discovered that the staff members who had been logged out were unable to log back in, even after receiving security codes and OTPs. Outlook outage affects the mobile app and web version of the service. According to Down Detector, the first spike in service outage reports from users was noticed in India on Thursday at 11:44 pm, with reports from 2,162 users. The number of user reports started coming down after midnight, reaching its lowest of 258 at 4:44 am on Friday. The second rise in user reports on the Outlook outage was recorded on Friday at 8:59 am, with 2,254 reports, outnumbering the spike on the previous day.
title: Outlook and Other Microsoft 365 Services Go Down in India as Users Report Failed Logins and Undelivered Emails
